layoutDesc.p: Folio 82r is the only one reporting the title "Áns saga" on the upper margin. Folio 83v shows a leaf on the lower margin and a letter y on the upper left margin. Folios 84v reports some writings on the upper margin and the drawing of a creature with a human face and dragon-like body on the lower margin. Folio 85r reports on the lower margin the incomplete drawing of a human face and a sketch of the body, plus a leaf. In folio 85v there are some writings on the lower margin.

projectDesc.p: The aim of this project is to offer an electronic source for the study of the copious abbreviations that characterize the medieval Old-Norse literary tradition in general, and to create an image-based electronic edition.
